title: Microsoft Teams: user setting to stop presence switching to Do not disturb while screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, call-handling behaviour and quoted user setting match the sources read. Searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in the default and admin controls; one checklist sentence should distinguish the presenting opt-out from other documented presence controls.

claims.quote: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing.

claims.quote: Normally, a user's status is based on user activity (whether they're Available or Away); on the state of the Teams app (for example, whether they're In a call or Presenting)

claims.claim: A Microsoft Q&A moderator tells screen-sharing users to go to Teams Settings > Privacy and uncheck Set my status to Do Not Disturb when I'm sharing my screen.
claims.quote:
If your status changes to "Do Not Disturb" when sharing your screen, go to Settings > Privacy in Teams.
Uncheck Set my status to Do Not Disturb when I'm sharing my screen.

claims.claim: The cited Q&A answer does not identify government clouds, so it does not confirm this path for GCC High and DoD.

Client Do Not Disturb and Breakthrough features are always enabled for users in Teams.
